description: A single component instance placed on the wireframe canvas. Stores position, size, component type, an optional authoring role, and a property bag (Props) that maps to the component's PropDef definitions. Props is a Dictionary<string, JsonElement> allowing any value type. Helper extension methods (GetString, GetInt, GetBool, etc.) on WireframeElementExtensions simplify prop access.

properties.name: Id
properties.description: Unique element ID. Auto-generated as an 8-char hex string (Guid prefix).

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Component type identifier matching a WireframeComponentDef.Type (e.g. 'TmButton', 'TmDataTable').

properties.name: Role
properties.description: Optional library-agnostic UI role requested during authoring, such as 'search-input' or 'otp-input'. Serialized as 'role' when present.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Optional human-readable element name (e.g. 'Login button'). Additive and descriptive: shown in the inspector, used as the element's aria-label and tooltip on the canvas and returned by the MCP tools. null (omitted from JSON) means unnamed.

properties.name: Props
properties.description: Component property bag. Keys are camelCase prop names matching PropDef.Name.

properties.name: ZIndex
properties.description: Rendering order. Higher values render on top.

properties.name: GroupId
properties.description: Optional group identifier. Null = not grouped. Omitted from JSON when null.

properties.name: IsLocked
properties.description: When true, the element cannot be moved, resized, or deleted.

properties.name: Rotation
properties.description: Rotation angle in degrees. 0 means no rotation.

properties.name: LayerId
properties.description: Optional layer identifier. Null = the default layer. Omitted from JSON when null.

properties.name: LockedBy
properties.description: Optional user identifier that has locked this element. Null = unlocked. Omitted from JSON when null.
